en.name: Barley, whole grain
en.summary: Whole grain barley — hulled or pot barley, with the bran and germ still on — keeps about 6 months in a sealed container in the cupboard and 12 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Pearl barley, which has been polished, keeps longer, because the polishing takes away the oily germ.
en.pantry: Store it airtight in a cool, dark, dry cupboard and use it within about 6 months. The bran and germ are what make whole barley worth eating and what limit its life: the germ carries oil, and oil goes rancid. Keep the jar away from the hob and out of the light. A glass jar you can see into is genuinely useful here, because the first sign of pantry moths is usually webbing rather than anything you smell.
en.fridge: No refrigerator figure is published for whole barley, so this page does not give one. The fridge is nonetheless a reasonable home for an opened bag in a humid kitchen, as long as the container is properly airtight — grain takes up both moisture and smells, and a cold jar opened in a warm kitchen collects condensation on whatever is inside. Bring it up to room temperature before you open it.
en.freezer: The freezer doubles the window to about 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F), in an airtight container or a heavy bag with the air pressed out. It is worth doing for a large bag, and it also kills off any weevil eggs that came home with a bulk purchase. Barley does not need thawing before cooking — measure it out frozen and add it straight to the pot.
spoilage: A bitter or paint-like smell from rancid germ oil.
A musty, damp smell, which usually means it has picked up moisture.
Webbing, small moths, or fine dust at the bottom of the jar.
Grains that stay hard and chalky however long you simmer them.
tips: Buy pearl barley instead if you use it rarely; polished grain keeps longer.
Decant bags into airtight jars as soon as you get home.
Freeze large bags on the day of purchase to settle any insect question.
Label with the date you bought it — a bag can sit on a shop shelf for months first.

faq.q: How long does whole grain barley keep?
faq.a: About 6 months airtight in a cool, dark cupboard, or 12 months at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Why does whole barley keep less time than pearl barley?
faq.a: Because it still has its germ, and the oil in the germ turns rancid. Pearling removes it along with the bran.
Yes, about 12 months at −18 °C in an airtight container. Cook it straight from frozen.

zh.name: 全粒大麥
zh.summary: 全粒大麥——只去外殼、仍保留麩皮與胚芽的大麥——密封放櫥櫃約 6 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 12 個月。經過拋光的珍珠麥（洋薏仁）比較耐放，因為拋光把含油的胚芽磨掉了。
zh.pantry: 密封裝罐，放陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，約 6 個月內用完。麩皮和胚芽既是全粒大麥值得吃的理由，也是限制它壽命的東西：胚芽含油，而油會走油耗。罐子請遠離爐台、避免光照。這裡用看得到內容物的玻璃罐特別實用，因為穀蛾最早的跡象通常是絲網，而不是你聞得到的味道。
zh.fridge: 全粒大麥沒有公布的冷藏數字，本頁也不給。不過在潮濕的廚房裡，開封後的袋子放冰箱仍然合理，前提是容器真的密封——穀物會同時吸水氣和氣味，而冰冷的罐子在溫暖廚房打開，裡面的東西就會結露。開封前先讓它回到室溫。
zh.freezer: 冷凍把期限拉長到 −18 °C 下約 12 個月，裝密封容器或厚袋壓出空氣。大包裝很值得這樣做，而且能順便殺掉散裝帶回來的蟲卵。大麥不需要解凍就能煮——直接量取冷凍的量下鍋即可。
spoilage: 聞到胚芽油走油耗後的苦味或油漆味。
有潮濕的霉味，通常代表它吸了水氣。
看到絲網、小蛾，或罐底出現細粉。
不管煮多久都硬硬粉粉、煮不軟。
tips: 很少用的話就改買珍珠麥；拋光過的比較耐放。
一回家就把袋裝的倒進密封罐。
大包裝買回來當天就冷凍，順便解決蟲的問題。
標上「購買日期」——一包穀物在店裡可能已經放了好幾個月。

faq.a: 密封、陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 6 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 12 個月。

faq.q: 為什麼全粒大麥比珍珠麥不耐放？
faq.a: 因為它還帶著胚芽，而胚芽裡的油會走油耗。拋光時把胚芽連同麩皮一起磨掉了。
可以，−18 °C 下密封容器約 12 個月，直接從冷凍下鍋煮即可。
